title: [IMP-9] Concurrent Commits: no rule chooses the winning Commit
description: Review finding IMP-9: Concurrent Commits: no rule chooses the winning Commit (lens IMP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:23, :203-205; spec/04-access-control.md:16. Fix: The normal path is mostly serialized already. 05:204 says "The committer obtains it from the service before publishing the Commit" and "at most one announcement per chain and `epoch`", so a careful loser cannot obtain a countersignature and does not publish. The gaps that remain: (1) the outage path (05:205) allows Commits while the service is unreachable, and the text does not say whether those may be published; (2) no rule tells clients to reject a Commit whose envelope lacks a countersigned announcement; (3) the loser's action is unstated; (4) `commitPolicy` has no schema (only 04:16). The fix follows from Q1: the Commit for epoch N+1 is the one carried with the countersigned announcement for N+1, no Commit is published without one (including during outage), and the loser discards and retries. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
